import sys

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    b = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    max_wins = 0
    max_loss_or_draw = 0
    for i in range(3):
        max_wins += min(a[i], b[(i + 1) % 3])
        max_lose = min(b[i], a[(i + 1) % 3])
        max_draw = min(b[i], a[i])
        max_loss_or_draw += min(b[i], max_lose + max_draw)
    print(n - max_loss_or_draw, max_wins)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
